defects.description: UI mockup cards on the right side are overlapping and colliding with each other in a messy stack
Subheadline text is very small and appears to have awkward line breaks or wrapping that reduces readability
UI mockup elements are floating without clear alignment or structured composition relative to the text content
Tight spacing between headline and subheadline, and between buttons and the mockup elements

top_fixes: Fix the overlapping UI mockup cards on the right - separate them into a clean, non-overlapping composition (grid or staggered layout)
Increase subheadline font size and fix line wrapping for better readability and hierarchy
Improve overall spacing consistency - add more breathing room between the text block, buttons, and the UI mockup area

manifest.prompt: Create a landing page hero section for a design tool called 'PixelForge': a bold headline 'Design at the speed of thought', a subheadline saying it turns prompts into polished UI in minutes, a primary 'Get Started' button and a secondary 'Watch Demo' button.
